method.classifier: multilingual keyword rules; primary type priority ETF > capital control > sanctions > ban/restriction > enforcement > stablecoin > tax > easing > licensing > legislation > CBDC
method.direction: dovish-term count minus hawkish-term count (+1 prior from type); bans/capital controls/enforcement/sanctions lean hawkish
method.severity: base by type (ban/capital control 3; sanctions/enforcement/ETF/stablecoin/legislation/easing 2; licensing/tax/CBDC 1) +1 US/CN/EU, +1 strong action words, +1 official regulator source, +1 if >= 3 distinct publishers; clamp 1-5
method.dedupe: title token Jaccard >= 0.5 within 72 h (Google News publisher suffix stripped); alerts also suppressed if Jaccard >= 0.6 vs any previously seen title
method.alerts: severity >= 4 and not seen before; the first run only records a baseline (initial_baseline=true). Stored in data/regradar_alerts.json; nothing is pushed externally.
